question: how do i find out why my financial aid hasnt shown up yet and who do i talk to

body.answer:
I can't see your personal records, like your grades, balance, schedule or financial aid status. Money stress is really common, and you don't have to sort it out alone.

Pending Financial Aid, also known as estimated or anticipated aid, appear in separate sections on the Account Summary screen. Memos are pending financial aid transactions that require further action. question: How do I set up a payment plan for spring semester tuition? and is there a fee to enroll in it

body.answer:
Student Accounts: The Spring 2027 plan offers four- and five-month options beginning November 16, 2026. The non-refundable $60 set-up fee is due at enrollment; the five-month plan requires a 20% down payment and the four-month plan requires a 25% down payment. [1]
1. Log into RCNJ Experience and enroll online before the semester’s posted payment deadline. [1]
2. Pay the down payment and $60 fee when you enroll. Further payments are due on the 15th of each month thereafter. [1]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [21]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/options-policies/) [21](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

pageFacts.question: How do I set up a payment plan for spring semester tuition? and is there a fee to enroll in it

facts.says: Spring 2027 Payment Plan Ramapo College offers two monthly payment plan options for the Spring semester beginning November 16, 2026, a four-month and a five-month plan.
The Ramapo Tuition Payment Plan (RTPP) for Spring requires a $60 set-up fee and a 20% down payment for the five-month plan, and a 25% down payment for the four-month plan.
Both are due at the time of enrollment.
Students must enroll in the plan prior to the posted payment deadline for the semester and enrollment must be done online by logging into RCNJ Experience.
The terms of the plan are as follows: Enrollment and the down payment for the plan is due by the appropriate payment deadline, with additional payments due on the 15th of each month thereafter.
You must pay your down payment along with your non-refundable $60 set-up fee at the time of enrollment.

question: refund

body.answer:
Student Accounts issues refunds based on the credit-balance threshold and offers paper checks or electronic refunds. [5]

- A Title IV financial aid overpayment resulting in a credit balance of $1.00 or greater will be refunded; non-Title IV financial aid credit balances have a $5.00 threshold. [5]
- Unless you specify otherwise, the College issues a paper check, mailed to your billing/permanent address; checks are not mailed to campus mailboxes and cannot be picked up in the Office of Student Accounts. [5]
- If you are entitled to a fall-term refund, you may request that it be applied to the spring term by emailing studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Spring refund proceeds cannot be applied to the following fall term. [5]
- Electronic refunds are free and deposit directly into a checking or savings account: Sign up for Electronic Refunds ([https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit/](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit/)) or Learn More About Electronic Refunds ([https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit-questions-answers/](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit-questions-answers/)). [5]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [11]

Sources: [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/deposits/) [11](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: what is the policy on withdrawing from a class after the deadline and does it affect my aid/satisfactory academic progress

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [23]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

**Financial Aid**
In order to receive financial aid, students must maintain Satisfactory Academic Progress add Sap policy link [https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/policies/#s1](https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/policies/#s1) ([https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/policies/#s1k](https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/policies/#s1k)). Students must file their 2023-2024 FAFSA form by the May 1 deadline. [3]
Quantitative Measure At the time of the SAP review, students’ academic records must show they are completing a minimum of 67% of credits attempted toward graduation requirements. This standard is the same for both graduate and undergraduate students. [4]

**Office of the Provost**
Dropping or withdrawing from a course may affect issues concerning, but not limited to, financial aid eligibility, satisfactory progress towards graduation, athletic compliance, housing status, and involvement in campus activities and functions. [6]

**Registrar**
Students may Withdraw from a course as follows: Web Self Service Instructions: Students may withdraw from a course online through Web Self Service by following the steps below Withdrawing from a Course ([https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2026/03/Withdrawing.pdf](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2026/03/Withdrawing.pdf)) Students with Registration Hold: Students who have holds can withdraw using the Withdrawal Form or by sending an email from their Ramapo Email Account toreg@ramapo.edu (mailto:reg@ramapo.edu) stating the following. Your Name (First and Last) Ramapo ID Number (aka R#) CRN (Course Identification Number) Subject (Example: INTD) Course Number (Example 100) Section Number (Example 01) Title of the Course A student may NOT withdraw after the published deadline. question: is my 1098-T available yet? need it for taxes and cant find where to get it. also how do i get a copy of last years

body.answer:
I can't see your personal records, like your grades, balance, schedule or financial aid status.

It depends: Student Accounts says Form 1098-T is provided each year on or before January 31, but these facts don’t confirm whether yours is available yet. [1]

Student Accounts: The IRS form is for tax purposes and can help students and families determine eligibility for the Hope Scholarship or Lifetime Learning Tax Credit. It applies to students with qualified tuition and related expenses and corresponding payments during the current tax year. Reported data covers January 1 through December 31 of the prior tax year, not the academic year. [1]

Students can view and print eligible forms in the Bill and Payment Suite; forms are not mailed. To get a copy of last year’s form:
1. Log into RCNJ Experience: [https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)
2. Locate the Student Account Info card and click the Bill & Payment Suite link.
3. Click the My Account tab at the top of the screen and select Statements.
4. Click the 1098-T Tax Statements tab.
5. Click View for the appropriate tax year. The PDF can be printed or saved. [2]

To opt in to a printed copy for the current tax year only, complete and submit the Revocation of Electronic 1098T form: [https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/wp-content/uploads/sites/147/2026/02/Revocation-of-Electronic-1098T_2026.pdf](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/wp-content/uploads/sites/147/2026/02/Revocation-of-Electronic-1098T_2026.pdf). It will be printed within 5-7 business days and mailed to the home address on file with the Registrar’s Office. [2]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [24]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/taxinfo/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/taxinfo/) [24](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: is it too late to withdraw from a class this semester and what happens to my transcript if i do

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [23]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

It depends on the course: the Full Semester withdrawal deadline has passed, but the Session II deadline has not. [23]

The Office of the Provost says that after the 50% refund period, you may withdraw no later than the last day to withdraw shown on the academic calendar ([https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/)) by accessing a withdrawal form online, completing a course withdrawal form in the Office of the Registrar, or withdrawing online through Web Self Service. [1] Once the Office of the Registrar processes the form, you receive a W for the course on your transcript. [1]

**Office of the Provost**: Phone: (201) 684-7330. Email: provost@ramapo.edu. Location: first floor of the Birch Mansion. [24]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#dropping-or-withdrawing-from-a-course1) [23](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/) [24](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

Once the withdrawal form is processed by the Office of the Registrar, the student will receive a W for the withdrawn course, and both student and instructor of record will receive notification that the student has withdrawn from the course.

value.page_words: If you require immediate assistance, problems such as no power, elevator malfunctions, plumbing leaks/clogs, no heat/AC any lock related problem, or health safety concerns please call the Service Desk at extension 7660, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM or Public Safety after these hours at extension 6666. If utilizing the online system on your own, please send only one request per issue. Our system will send automatic email notifications to the sender when the request is processed, when the status changes and when the work is complete. If you have any questions or concerns regarding your request, you may call our Service Desk at extension 7660; please reference the request number generated by the system when you call. return to top Asbestos: The College Park apartments were built before 1980, and some of their construction materials contain asbestos. Buckeye, Holly, International, Mimosa, Elm, Palm, Redwood, Hickory, Science, Mulberry, and Cypress have been renovated and are asbestos-free. Materials that contain asbestos include floor tiles/mastic and joint compound in walls and ceilings. These materials present no hazard unless they are impaired or disturbed. Puncturing these materials could cause a release of asbestos fibers. Please do not insert nails, tacks, hooks or otherwise impair or disturb the materials. If you notice any damage, please vacate the apartment

**Facilities Management**

Hours: Monday to Friday: 7:30am-4:30pm; Saturday and Sunday: Not published. Start date: not published. End date: not published. Published note: Administrative Offices Monday - Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. [campus-hours](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/)

Contact note: You can submit a request using any of the following methods: Using the TMA iService Desk: Online Service Request Portal By Telephone: 201-684-7660 For Media, ITS and Telecomm requests please visit https://helpdesk.ramapo.edu/ If you require immediate assistance, problems such as no power, elevator malfunctions, plumbing leaks/clogs, no heat/AC any lock related problem, or health safety concerns please call the Service Desk at extension 7660. Any emergencies that occur between 4:30 p.m. and 7:30 a.m. OR on weekends should be reported to Public Safety at extension 6666. pageFacts.question: whats my current balance and do i have any holds on my account. How do I check my current balance and whether I have any holds on my account?

facts.says: In addition to checking your Ramapo e-Mail account, it is important to log onto the RCNJ Experience (Web Self-Service) (https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/) to periodically view your student account.
Any student who has not paid in-full and has an outstanding balance will have a Hold Flag placed on their account.
Hold flags prevent future registration, changes to existing registration, entrance into housing, and receipt of a diploma.
Once a student’s account is paid-in-full, the Hold Flag will be removed.
Please be aware, a student may still have a hold flag from another office or department which could prevent registration.

question: My RA wrote me up for a candle. what happens now? do i have to go to a hearing

body.answer:
The fire-safety sanctions page lists, for “Activating a fire alarm due to a disregard of a published policy” (including use of candles): first offense, a $150.00 fine and a fire-safety reflection assignment; second offense, a $300.00 fine, disciplinary probation, and possible suspension or loss of housing privileges. It doesn’t say whether your candle write-up requires a hearing. [10]
The Office of Student Conduct says to refer to Section K of the Code of Conduct for hearing rights. If you are charged and need to request an excuse from a hearing, its page lists serious illness or hospitalization (physician’s letter within five business days), death of an immediate family member or someone in your domicile (death notice or certificate), a serious emergency at your permanent home (written local police verification), arrest and incarceration (written court or police verification), or unavoidable transportation delay (written police documentation from where it occurred). [8][9]
For an answer about your specific write-up or whether you must attend, contact the Office of Student Conduct.

**Office of Student Conduct**: Phone: (201) 684-7869. Email: studentconduct@ramapo.edu. Office: C-212. [24]

Sources: [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-conduct/hearing/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-conduct/frequently-asked-questions/) [10](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-conduct/fire-safety/) [24](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: I got a credit balance on my student account after my aid posted, how do I get that money sent to me? Do I need to sign up for direct deposit or does it just get mailed?

body.answer:
**Student Accounts**
Log into RCNJ Experience ([https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)) Locate the Student Account Info card Click on Bill & Payment Suite Click on Electronic Refunds on the right hand side of the screen under the My Profile Setup menu You must enroll in a Two-Step Verification Process (If previously completed, skip this step) Click on the Security Settings tab in My Profile Select a method to receive a passcode (text message, email or Google Authentication) Click the Send Code button Enter the passcode and click the Verify button Click on the Payment Profile tab in My Profile Edit existing saved Payment Method or Create New Payment Method When either editing an existing payment method or creating a new one, click on check box in the Refund Option section to designate this payment method as the refund account for direct deposit. [1]
Should a Title IV financial aid overpayment result in a credit balance of $1.00 or greater, a refund will be issued. Credit balances from non-Title IV financial aid are subject to a $5.00 threshold. question: how do i switch roommates? we're not getting along at all

body.answer:
Roommate problems are really common, and they can be worked out. Your RA is a good first step.

Housing & Residence Life:
1. Once housing assignments are made, room changes can’t be accommodated before the semester starts. [1]
2. During the open room change period, submit a Room Change Request Form. [2]
3. Visit the Room Change Process webpage ([https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/)) for important dates, instructions, step-by-step details, and the digital Room Change Request Form, which is available during active room change periods. [3][4][5]
4. Before submitting, review the full process and check the Residence Life Events & Important Dates calendar ([https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/critical-housing-dates-deadlines-calendar/](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/critical-housing-dates-deadlines-calendar/)) to understand how a room change might affect you. Room changes are not guaranteed. [6]

**Housing & Residence Life**: Phone: (201) 684-7461. Email: reslife@ramapo.edu. [22]

This office can help:
**Ombuds Office**: Phone: (201) 684-7804. Email: jwoods1@ramapo.edu. [23]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/new-student-guide/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/gtcl/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/fallcheckoutandwinter/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/gtcl/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/) [22](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/) [23](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: Missed 3 classes last week because I was in the hospital. How do I get my professors to excuse the absences, is there an office that sends a note or something?

body.answer:
I'm sorry you're dealing with that, and I hope you feel better soon.

1. Health Promotion says to communicate directly with your professors about missing classes [1].
2. Admissions says to speak with your instructors about making up missed work; course attendance is determined by the instructor [2].
3. The listed guidance does not identify an office that sends a note [1][2][14].

- **Health Promotion**: Email: studentwellness@ramapo.edu. Wellness Is Now office: E-211A. [25]
- **Admissions**: Phone: (201) 684-7300. Email: admissions@ramapo.edu. Location: McBride House. [25]

These offices can help:
- **Health Services**: Phone: (201) 684-7536. Location: Near the campus South Gate entrance at the corner of Route 202 and Hornbeam Road. [26]
- **Center for Student Success (Academic Advising)**: Phone: (201) 684-7441. Email: success@ramapo.edu. Office: D-207. [26]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/health-promotion/immune-disease-tips/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/adult-students/faqs/) [14](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/disabilities-and-teaching-strategies-accommodations/) [25](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/) [26](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: How do I set up a payment plan for spring semester tuition? and is there a fee to enroll in it

body.answer:
Student Accounts: The non-refundable set-up fee is $60. [2][6]
1. Choose the four-month or five-month Spring plan, available beginning November 16, 2026. [1]
2. Enroll online by logging into RCNJ Experience before the semester’s posted payment deadline. The down payment and $60 fee are due at enrollment: 25% for the four-month plan or 20% for the five-month plan. [2][4][6]
3. Additional payments are due on the 15th of each month thereafter. Enrolling after the down payment due date requires paying missed installments at enrollment; missing the payment deadline may result in a $200 late fee and/or course deregistration. [5][7]
For example, enrolling in the four-month plan on February 25 requires the down payment, the February 15 installment, and the $60 enrollment fee at enrollment. Past-due balances from previous semesters of $500 or greater must be paid before you are eligible to enroll. [8]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [21]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/options-policies/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/affordability/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/faq/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/payment-policies/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/costinfo/course-fee/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/summer/policies/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/summer/undergraduate-registration/) [21](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

pageFacts.question: How do I set up a payment plan for spring semester tuition? and is there a fee to enroll in it

facts.says: Spring 2027 Payment Plan Ramapo College offers two monthly payment plan options for the Spring semester beginning November 16, 2026, a four-month and a five-month plan.
The Ramapo Tuition Payment Plan (RTPP) for Spring requires a $60 set-up fee and a 20% down payment for the five-month plan, and a 25% down payment for the four-month plan.
Both are due at the time of enrollment.
Students must enroll in the plan prior to the posted payment deadline for the semester and enrollment must be done online by logging into RCNJ Experience.
The terms of the plan are as follows: Enrollment and the down payment for the plan is due by the appropriate payment deadline, with additional payments due on the 15th of each month thereafter.
You must pay your down payment along with your non-refundable $60 set-up fee at the time of enrollment.

Students who do not enroll by the payment deadline may be subject to a $200 late fee and/or deregistration from their courses Enrollment in the plan beyond the due date for the down payment requires payment of any missed installments at the time of enrollment.

As an example, enrollment in our four month plan on February 25 requires payment of the down payment, the February 15 installment, and the $60 enrollment fee at time of enrollment Past due balances from previous semesters of $500 or greater must be paid prior to a student being eligible to enroll in the plan.

question: whats the deadline to file the FAFSA for next year and what does ramapo need from me besides that

body.answer:

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [23]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)

**Financial Aid**
Returning learners are eligible for GSG as long as, in addition to the above criteria, the student meets Ramapo’s Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) policy and definition For other financial aid questions, contact finaid@ramapo.edu (mailto:finaid@ramapo.edu) For other undergraduate admissions questions, contact information@ramapo.edu (mailto:information@ramapo.edu). Dropping or withdrawing from a course may affect issues concerning, but not limited to, financial aid eligibility, satisfactory progress towards graduation, athletic compliance, housing status, and involvement in campus activities and functions. [6]

question: is my 1098-T available yet? need it for taxes and cant find where to get it. also how do i get a copy of last years

body.answer:
I can't see your personal records, like your grades, balance, schedule or financial aid status.

It depends: Student Accounts says the 1098-T is provided each year on or before January 31, but doesn’t say whether it’s available earlier. [1] The form is for tax purposes; eligibility requires qualified tuition and related expenses and corresponding payments during the current tax year, and the form reports the prior tax year (January 1 through December 31), not the academic year. [1]

To check or get last year’s copy, Student Accounts says eligible students can view and print forms in the Bill and Payment Suite; forms are not mailed. [2]
1. Log into RCNJ Experience ([https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)).
2. Locate the Student Account Info card and click the Bill & Payment Suite link.
3. Click the My Account tab, select Statements, then click the 1098-T Tax Statements tab.
4. Click View for the appropriate tax year. The PDF can be printed or saved. [2]

To receive a printed copy for the current tax year only, complete and submit a Revocation of Electronic 1098T form ([https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/wp-content/uploads/sites/147/2026/02/Revocation-of-Electronic-1098T_2026.pdf](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/wp-content/uploads/sites/147/2026/02/Revocation-of-Electronic-1098T_2026.pdf)) to the Office of Student Accounts. The form will be printed within 5-7 business days and mailed to the home address on file with the Registrar’s Office. [2]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [24]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/taxinfo/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/taxinfo/) [24](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: I'm a commuter student and I have a 3 hour gap between classes. Is there somewhere on campus I can study or hang out, like a commuter lounge, and is there a way to store my stuff?

body.answer:
Yes. Center for Student Involvement: J. Lee’s is the unofficial Commuter Lounge, where students can kick back and relax before or after classes. It has video games, a pool table, a ping pong table, and FREE POPCORN! It is in the student center on the second floor between the Student Government office and the Black Student Union office. [3] You can rent small or medium lockers at the Student Center Office during the academic semesters. The lockers are in the second-floor stairwell area, between B and C buildings. Rental is $10.00 for the semester or $20.00 for the academic year; a key is issued with payment and must be returned at the end of the semester. [5][6][7] Library: Private and group study spaces are available on every floor. [20]

- **Center for Student Involvement**: Phone: (201) 684-7593. Email: csi@ramapo.edu. Office: SC-202. [25]
- **Library**: Phone: (201) 684-7575. Email: circ@ramapo.edu. Location: Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons. [25]

Sources: [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/csi/commuter-affairs/involvement-frequently-asked-questions/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/csi/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/csi/commuter-affairs/commuter-resources/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/csi/commuter-affairs/involvement-frequently-asked-questions/) [20](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/floor-guide-to-materials-and-services/) [25](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

Roommate problems are really common, and they can be worked out. Your RA is a good first step.

question: is it too late to withdraw from a class this semester and what happens to my transcript if i do

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [23]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

It depends on your course: the Session II deadline has not passed, but the other Fall 2026 course deadlines listed above have passed [23]. The Office of the Provost says you may withdraw after the 50% refund period through the last day to withdraw on the academic calendar ([https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/)), using an online withdrawal form, a course withdrawal form in the Office of the Registrar, or Web Self Service [1]. Once the Office of the Registrar processes the withdrawal, you receive a W for the course [1].

**Office of the Provost**: Phone: (201) 684-7330. Email: provost@ramapo.edu. Location: first floor of the Birch Mansion. [24]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#dropping-or-withdrawing-from-a-course1) [23](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/) [24](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

facts.says: A student who decides to withdraw from a course after the 50% refund period (but no later than the last day to withdraw from a course, as indicated on the academic calendar (https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/)) may do so by accessing a withdrawal form online, completing a course withdrawal form in the Office of the Registrar, or, withdrawing online through Web Self Service.

Once the withdrawal form is processed by the Office of the Registrar, the student will receive a W for the withdrawn course, and both student and instructor of record will receive notification that the student has withdrawn from the course.

answer.text:
**Facilities Management**

Phones: +12016847660; +12016847670 (Receiving / Storeroom) [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/) [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/facilities-contacts/) [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-request-portal/) [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-guide/)

Offices: P-FAC [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/) [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/facilities-contacts/) [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-request-portal/) [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-guide/)

Hours: Monday to Friday: 7:30am-4:30pm; Saturday and Sunday: Not published. Start date: not published. End date: not published. Published note: Administrative Offices Monday - Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. [campus-hours](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/)

Contact note: You can submit a request using any of the following methods: Using the TMA iService Desk: Online Service Request Portal By Telephone: 201-684-7660 For Media, ITS and Telecomm requests please visit https://helpdesk.ramapo.edu/ If you require immediate assistance, problems such as no power, elevator malfunctions, plumbing leaks/clogs, no heat/AC any lock related problem, or health safety concerns please call the Service Desk at extension 7660. Any emergencies that occur between 4:30 p.m. and 7:30 a.m. OR on weekends should be reported to Public Safety at extension 6666. [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/) [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/facilities-contacts/) [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-request-portal/) [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-guide/)

How-to and policies: Get immediate assistance for an urgent Facilities problem: 1. For no power, elevator malfunctions, plumbing leaks or clogs, no heat or AC, lock problems, or health and safety concerns, call the Service Desk at extension 7660. \(page: “If you require immediate assistance, problems such as no power, elevator malfunctions, plumbing leaks/clogs, no heat/AC any lock related problem, or health safety concerns please call the Service Desk at extension 7660.”\) (see https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-guide/) [office-pages](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-guide/)

How-to and policies: Submit a Facilities work request: 1. Use the TMA iService Desk and Online Service Request Portal. \(page: “Using the TMA iService Desk: Online Service Request Portal \(https://ramapocollege.webtma.com/app/request/cb3dd15e-4c5a-435c-8c85-5d39c47951c6\)”\) 2. Call 201-684-7660. \(page: “By Telephone: 201-684-7660”\) (see https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-request-portal/) [office-pages](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-request-portal/)

How-to and policies: Report an after-hours or weekend emergency: 1. Report emergencies occurring between 4:30 p.m. and 7:30 a.m., or on weekends, to Public Safety at extension 6666. \(page: “Any emergencies that occur between 4:30 p.m. and 7:30 a.m. OR on weekends should be reported to Public Safety at extension 6666.”\) (see https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-guide/) [office-pages](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-guide/)

How-to and policies: Request routine Facilities service: 1. Submit a service request using the Service Request Form. \(page: “To request services click on the button below. Service Request Form \(https://ramapocollege.webtma.com/app/request/d4d71f56-79f4-47b2-98d6-5a7b536b4f2a\)”\) 2. How-to and policies: For the protection of all of the college community, the Office of Facilities urges:: disabled persons should evacuate the building if they are on the first floor. If a disabled person is above the first floor, he or she should go to the nearest Area of Rescue Assistance and notify Public Safety of their location. There is a phone in each area of rescue assistance that automatically dials Public Safety. Disabled persons should stay in this area and await help. Below is a list of Ar… (see https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/safety/) [office-pages](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/safety/)

How-to and policies: Request space: 1. Email the Committee Chair with your space request. \(page: “Space requestors should direct an email to the Committee Chair.”\) 2. Briefly describe the purpose, suggested locations, desired timeline, physical attributes, unit head support, and budget or funding request. \(page: “The email should denote in brief: • Purpose of the space being requested and how it may or may not clearly advance the Co… (see https://www.ramapo.edu/policies/policy/space-management/) [office-pages](https://www.ramapo.edu/policies/policy/space-management/)

How-to and policies: Respond if a fire extinguisher has been discharged: 1. Do not tamper with fire suppression devices. \(page: “Do not tamper with any of these devices.”\) 2. If you discharged a manual fire extinguisher, contact Public Safety at Ext. 6666 and the Facilities Service Desk at Ext. 7663 so a replacement can be installed. \(page: “If you discharged a manual fire extinguisher for any reason, contact Public Safety immediately at Ext. 6666, and the Facilities S… (see https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/safety/) [office-pages](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/safety/)

How-to and policies: Notify Facilities of changes to scheduled departure or return times: 1. Notify the Office of Facilities in advance of changes to scheduled departure or return times. \(page: “The Office of Facilities should be notified in advance, of changes to scheduled departure or return time\(s\).”\) (see https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/vehicle-schedule/) [office-pages](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/vehicle-schedule/)

How-to and policies: Report an accident or vehicle damage: 1. Report any accident or vehicle damage to Public Safety immediately and file an accident report. \(page: “Driver is required to report any accident or damage to the vehicle to Public Safety immediately and file an accident report.”\) (see https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/vehicle-schedule/) [office-pages](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/vehicle-schedule/)

How-to and policies: Get approval before permanently repurposing classroom space: 1. Get approval from the Provost or their designee before permanently repurposing classroom space. \(page: “Unless approved by the Provost or their designee, classroom space cannot be permanently repurposed.”\) (see https://www.ramapo.edu/policies/policy/space-management/) [office-pages](https://www.ramapo.edu/policies/policy/space-management/)

How-to and policies: Related Resources: Comprehensive Facilities Plan \(PDF\) \(https://www.ramapo.edu/president/wp-content/uploads/sites/41/securepdfs/2024/01/Revitalize-Renew-Retool-Comprehensive-Facilities-Plan-2024.pdf\) Environmental Health & Safety \(https://www.ramapo.edu/ehs/\) Campus Map \(https://map.ramapo.edu/?id=2292\#\!ct/99549,99550,99551\) Telephone Directory \(https://web.ramapo.edu/phone/\) (see https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/sustainability/) [office-pages](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/sustainability/)

How-to and policies: Report a safety or security concern involving keys or locks: 1. Report the concern to the Office of Facilities Management Service Desk at extension 7660 or Public Safety at extension 6666. \(page: “Safety and security concerns stemming from key or lock issues should be reported to the Office of Facilities Management Service Desk at extension 7660 or to Public Safety at extension 6666.”\) (see https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/keys-and-locks/) [office-pages](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/keys-and-locks/)

How-to and policies: General Unit Contact: Service Desk: \(201\) 684-7660 Receiving / Storeroom: \(201\) 684-7670 Other Contacts \(https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/wp-content/uploads/sites/143/2023/03/How-to-Report-a-Concern-sign-8.5x5.5-1.23.pdf\) (see https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/) [office-pages](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/)

How-to and policies: Request phone service: 1. Call extension 7777 or email telecomm@ramapo.edu. \(page: “All requests for Phone Service should be called into extension 7777 or emailed to telecomm@ramapo.edu”\) (see https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-guide/) [office-pages](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-guide/)

question: I got a credit balance on my student account after my aid posted, how do I get that money sent to me? Do I need to sign up for direct deposit or does it just get mailed?

body.answer:
**Student Accounts**
Log into RCNJ Experience ([https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)) Locate the Student Account Info card Click on Bill & Payment Suite Click on Electronic Refunds on the right hand side of the screen under the My Profile Setup menu You must enroll in a Two-Step Verification Process (If previously completed, skip this step) Click on the Security Settings tab in My Profile Select a method to receive a passcode (text message, email or Google Authentication) Click the Send Code button Enter the passcode and click the Verify button Click on the Payment Profile tab in My Profile Edit existing saved Payment Method or Create New Payment Method When either editing an existing payment method or creating a new one, click on check box in the Refund Option section to designate this payment method as the refund account for direct deposit. [1]
Should a Title IV financial aid overpayment result in a credit balance of $1.00 or greater, a refund will be issued. Credit balances from non-Title IV financial aid are subject to a $5.00 threshold. Unless otherwise specified by the student, the College will issue a paper check. Paper Check Refund – Checks will be mailed to the student’s billing/permanent address. Spring refund proceeds cannot be applied to the following fall term Electronic/Direct Deposit Refund – This free electronic refund service will deposit refunds directly into a student’s checking or savings account Sign up for Electronic Refunds ([https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit/](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit/)) Learn More About Electronic Refunds ([https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit-questions-answers/](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit-questions-answers/)) The College reserves the right to change costs, dates and procedures at its discretion. [2]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [20]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/deposits/) [20](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: how do i add my parent as an authorized user so they can pay my bill

body.answer:
Student Accounts: Adding your parent as an Authorized User permits them to make payments on your behalf, receive e-bill email notifications, and join the Ramapo Monthly Payment Plan (RTPP). [2]

1. Log into RCNJ Experience ([https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)), locate the Student Account Info card, and click Bill & Payment Suite. [3]
2. Click Authorized Users on the right side of the page in the My Profile Setup section, then click the Add Authorized User tab. [3]
3. Enter your parent’s email address, answer the questions, and click Continue. Click the I Agree box, then Continue. [3]
4. If your parent should only make payments, select the ‘No’ radio button for both the View billing statement and View payment history radio buttons. [1]
5. Your authorized user will be emailed a link to the Bill and Payment Suite, and the email will provide a user name and password. [1]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [11]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/billpolicies/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/users/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/users/) [11](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: I lost my ID card, how do I get a replacement

body.answer:
Sorry to hear that!

1. Public Safety: If your Ramapo College ID is lost or stolen, deactivate it immediately to prevent fraudulent use by contacting the ID Card Room at (201)-684-7789. [3]

3. Public Safety: The ID room will reprint the ID card and leave it at the front of the Public Safety Office for pickup. You will receive an e-mail when it is ready. [1]
4. Public Safety: The replacement fee for a lost ID card is $25. [1]

- **Public Safety (Non-Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-7432. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [11]
- **Public Safety (Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-6666. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [11]

question: how do i switch roommates? we're not getting along at all

body.answer:
Roommate problems are really common, and they can be worked out. Your RA is a good first step.

1. Housing & Residence Life: Submit a Room Change Request Form during an open room change period. The Room Change Process webpage has important dates and instructions: [https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/) [1][2]
2. Housing & Residence Life: Review the Room Change Process webpage for step-by-step details and the digital Room Change Request Form, which is available during active room change periods. Check the Residence Life Events & Important Dates calendar to understand how a room change might affect you: [https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/critical-housing-dates-deadlines-calendar/](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/critical-housing-dates-deadlines-calendar/). Room changes are not guaranteed. [4][5][6]
3. Housing & Residence Life: Once the open room change period ends, contact your hall office for guidance on available options. [3]

**Housing & Residence Life**: Phone: (201) 684-7461. Email: reslife@ramapo.edu. [22]

This office can help:
**Ombuds Office**: Phone: (201) 684-7804. Email: jwoods1@ramapo.edu. [23]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/new-student-guide/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/gtcl/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/fallcheckoutandwinter/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/gtcl/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/) [22](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/) [23](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: Missed 3 classes last week because I was in the hospital. How do I get my professors to excuse the absences, is there an office that sends a note or something?

body.answer:
I'm sorry you're dealing with that, and I hope you feel better soon.

1. Office of Specialized Services: Contact your faculty member after the absence, account for it, and ask if and when work may be made up. [11]
2. Admissions: Course attendance is determined by the instructor. [2] In an emergency or conflict, speak with instructors about whether you can connect remotely and how to make up missed work. [2]

- **Office of Specialized Services**: Phone: (201) 684-7514. Email: oss@ramapo.edu. Location: C-Wing, Room 205. [19]
- **Admissions**: Phone: (201) 684-7300. Email: admissions@ramapo.edu. Location: McBride House. [19]

These offices can help:
- **Health Services**: Phone: (201) 684-7536. Location: Near the campus South Gate entrance at the corner of Route 202 and Hornbeam Road. [20]
- **Center for Student Success (Academic Advising)**: Phone: (201) 684-7441. Email: success@ramapo.edu. Office: D-207. [20]

Sources: [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/adult-students/faqs/) [11](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/disabilities-and-teaching-strategies-accommodations/) [19](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/) [20](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: can alumni still use career services and the library after graduating

body.answer:
Yes, alumni can use career services and some library services after graduating. The Office of Alumni Relations says alumni can access the Cahill Career Center services on the Ramapo campus, including help with job searches, resume updates, and interviewing skills [2]. It also says alumni can use the library’s online services, borrow books, and access the Learning Commons [1].

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/alumni/benefits/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/alumni/benefits/)

question: how do i get a work study job on campus? i have it in my aid package but idk where to apply

question: how do i find out why my financial aid hasnt shown up yet and who do i talk to

body.answer:
I can't see your personal records, like your grades, balance, schedule or financial aid status. Money stress is really common, and you don't have to sort it out alone.

Student Accounts: Check the Account Summary screen, where Pending Financial Aid (estimated or anticipated aid) appears in a separate section. [1] Memos are pending financial aid transactions that require further action; aid shown as a Memo other than a New Jersey Class Loan, Alternative Loan, or Outside Scholarship has not met all requirements for payment. [2][4] If the Memo is a New Jersey Class Loan, Alternative Loan, or Outside Scholarship, no further action needs to be taken on your part. [3] Contact the Office of Financial Aid to resolve outstanding issues. [5] To chat with a representative from another Enrollment Management office, see: Admissions ([https://www.ramapo.edu/admissions/live-chat/](https://www.ramapo.edu/admissions/live-chat/)); Center for Student Success ([https://www.ramapo.edu/studentsuccess/chat/](https://www.ramapo.edu/studentsuccess/chat/)); Office of the Registrar ([https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/chat/](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/chat/)); Office of Financial Aid ([https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/chat/](https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/chat/)); Cahill Career Development Center; Residence Life ([https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/chat/](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/chat/)). [19]

- **Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [25]
- **Financial Aid**: Phone: (201) 684-7549. Email: finaid@ramapo.edu. Office: E-210. [25]

question: How do I set up a payment plan for spring semester tuition? and is there a fee to enroll in it

body.answer:
Student Accounts: The Spring 2027 options are a four-month or five-month plan, beginning November 16, 2026. [1] The non-refundable set-up fee is $60. [2][6]
1. Enroll online by logging into RCNJ Experience prior to the posted payment deadline for the semester. [4]
2. At enrollment, pay the $60 fee and the down payment: 20% for the five-month plan or 25% for the four-month plan. [2][3][6]
3. Make additional payments on the 15th of each month thereafter. [5]

question: is my 1098-T available yet? need it for taxes and cant find where to get it. also how do i get a copy of last years

body.answer:
I can't see your personal records, like your grades, balance, schedule or financial aid status.

It depends on the tax year; Student Accounts says Form 1098-T is provided each year on or before January 31, but these facts don’t confirm whether this year’s form is available yet. [1]

Student Accounts says the form is for tax purposes and may help determine eligibility for the Hope Scholarship or Lifetime Learning Tax Credit. It reports the prior tax year (January 1 through December 31), not the academic year. [1]

To check or get a copy of last year’s form:
1. Log into RCNJ Experience ([https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)).
2. Locate the Student Account Info card and click Bill & Payment Suite.
3. Click My Account, select Statements, then click the 1098-T Tax Statements tab.
4. Click View for the appropriate tax year. The PDF can be printed or saved. Eligible students can view and print annual forms there; forms are not mailed. [2]

To opt in to a printed copy for the current tax year only, complete the Revocation of Electronic 1098T form ([https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/wp-content/uploads/sites/147/2026/02/Revocation-of-Electronic-1098T_2026.pdf](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/wp-content/uploads/sites/147/2026/02/Revocation-of-Electronic-1098T_2026.pdf)) and submit it to the Office of Student Accounts. A form will be printed within 5-7 business days and mailed to the home address on file with the Registrar’s Office. [2]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [24]

Orientation Programs:

body.answer:
I can't send messages or make changes for you, like registering, dropping a class or making a payment.

The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [25]:
- Friday, August 28, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day of Add/Drop for 100% Tuition Refund (already passed)
- Tuesday, September 1, 2026: Full Semester Courses - Last Day of Add/Drop for 100% Tuition Refund (already passed)
- Wednesday, October 21, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Add/Drop for 100% Tuition Refund (already passed)
- Thursday, December 17, 2026: Last Day to Add/Drop Winter Classes with 100% Tuition Refund (also on the Winter 2027 calendar)

The deadline to drop without a W is not stated here; the Registrar says to review the Academic Calendar ([https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/)) for important deadline dates [21]. question: how do i get a parking permit and how much does it cost

body.answer:
Orientation Programs: The cost is not stated in the available information. [14]
1. All students must apply for a permit online. [14]
2. To access the parking permit application, log on directly to ThePermitStore.com website at [https://ramapo.thepermitstore.com/](https://ramapo.thepermitstore.com/). [14]
3. Enter Ramapo as your parking destination, then, click Submit. [14]
4. On the search: results page, click on Ramapo College of New Jersey. [14]
5. On the home: option selection page, click Apply. [14]
6. On the login page, read the Terms and Conditions statement and click I Agree. [14]
7. Then, enter your Email Address and Password. [14]
8. Then, click Continue. To complete the parking permit application, Step 1: personal information: Complete all of the required fields. [14]
9. Then, click Continue. Step 2: select permit(s): Select the permit you wish to obtain by clicking on the appropriate BUY button. [14]
10. Step 3: vehicle information: Complete all required fields, then, click Add This Vehicle. [14]

**Orientation Programs**: Phone: (201) 684-7441. Email: orient@ramapo.edu. Office: D-207. [31]

question: is it too late to withdraw from a class this semester and what happens to my transcript if i do

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [23]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

It depends on the course [23]. The Office of the Provost says a student may withdraw after the 50% refund period, but no later than the last day to withdraw shown on the academic calendar ([https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/)), by accessing a withdrawal form online, completing a course withdrawal form in the Office of the Registrar, or withdrawing online through Web Self Service [1]. Once the Office of the Registrar processes the withdrawal form, the student receives a W for the course [1].

**Office of the Provost**: Phone: (201) 684-7330. Email: provost@ramapo.edu. Location: first floor of the Birch Mansion. [24]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#dropping-or-withdrawing-from-a-course1) [23](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/) [24](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: something fell off the ceiling in my bathroom and theres a leak. who do I call at night, public safety or facilities?

body.answer:
I'm sorry you're dealing with that. You're not alone, and you can ask for help.

**Facilities Management**

Phones: (201) 684-7660; (201) 684-7670 (Receiving / Storeroom) [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/)

Offices: P-FAC [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/)

Hours: Monday to Friday: 7:30am-4:30pm; Saturday and Sunday: Not published. Start date: not published. End date: not published. Published note: Administrative Offices Monday - Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/)

Contact note: You can submit a request using any of the following methods: Using the TMA iService Desk: Online Service Request Portal By Telephone: 201-684-7660 For Media, ITS and Telecomm requests please visit [https://helpdesk.ramapo.edu/](https://helpdesk.ramapo.edu/) If you require immediate assistance, problems such as no power, elevator malfunctions, plumbing leaks/clogs, no heat/AC any lock related problem, or health safety concerns please call the Service Desk at extension 7660. Any emergencies that occur between 4:30 p.m. and 7:30 a.m. OR on weekends should be reported to Public Safety at extension 6666. [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/)

Report an after-hours or weekend emergency: 1. Report emergencies occurring between 4:30 p.m. and 7:30 a.m., or on weekends, to Public Safety at extension 6666. \(page: “Any emergencies that occur between 4:30 p.m. and 7:30 a.m. OR on weekends should be reported to Public Safety at extension 6666.”\) [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-guide/)

Get immediate assistance for an urgent Facilities problem: 1. For no power, elevator malfunctions, plumbing leaks or clogs, no heat or AC, lock problems, or health and safety concerns, call the Service Desk at extension 7660. \(page: “If you require immediate assistance, problems such as no power, elevator malfunctions, plumbing leaks/clogs, no heat/AC any lock related problem, or health safety concerns please call the Service Desk at extension 7660.”\) [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-guide/)

**Public Safety \(Non-Emergency\)**

Phones: (201) 684-7432; (201) 684-7789 (Director of Public Safety); (201) 684-7011 (Ramapo College Public Safety TDD) [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/)

Offices: C-102 [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/)

Hours: Monday to Sunday: 24 hours. Start date: not published. End date: not published. Published note: The Public Safety Department is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year. [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/get-support/)

Contact note: If there is an imminent danger to a student, or to the community, contact the Public Safety Department at \(201\) 684-6666. Public Safety Contact Information: secdesk@ramapo.edu Parking Permits: parkingpermits@ramapo.edu [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/)

**Public Safety \(Emergency\)**

Phones: (201) 684-6666; (201) 684-7789 (Director of Public Safety); (201) 684-7011 (Ramapo College Public Safety TDD) [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/)

**Housing & Residence Life**

Contact the right office for a facilities emergency: 1. Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM: call Facilities at 201-684-7660. \(page: “Mon–Fri, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM \| The Office of Facilities \([https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/)\) \| 201-684-7660”\) 2. After 4:30 PM and on weekends: call Public Safety at 201-684-6666. \(page: “After 4:30 PM & Weekends \| Public Safety \| 201-684-6666”\) 3. 8:00 PM–12:00 midnight: contact the RA Hall Office. \(page: “8:00 PM–12:00 Midni… [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/gtcl/)

**Events and Conferences**

Report an emergency in Padovano Commons: 1. Immediately report emergencies to Public Safety at x6666 or call 911. \(page: “Emergencies should immediately be reported to Public Safety \(x6666\) or call 911.”\) [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/conferences/padovano-commons/)

This office can help:
**Civic and Community Engagement Center**: Phone: (201) 684-7586. Email: ccec@ramapo.edu. Office: SC-213. [1]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

The reservation requestor is responsible for advising the campus, through the Daily Digest or signage at the Commons, when a program is being held. The purpose of this notification is to both promote the program and to extend a courtesy to those community members who may wish to find an alternative on-campus space to gather. value.page_words: Emergencies should immediately be reported to Public Safety (x6666) or call 911. Reserving Padovano Commons:: Groups may gather or meet in Padovano Commons dining room/lounge area without official reservations. Faculty/Staff may request use of the Glass Room for up to 8 people at a conference table M-F from 8 a.m. – 4 p.m. Requests can be made through 25Live. Students may request use of the Commons M-W from 5 p.m. – 12 Midnight by contacting the Center for Student Involvement at csi@ramapo.edu. The Commons will not typically be reserved in its entirety for daytime events prior to 4pm. Special approval will be required and notice will be posted. For special events, four 6′ tables can be set-up in the Glass Room. Even when reserved for a gathering for daytime events prior to 4pm, the space will remain open to faculty and staff. Faculty and staff who are not participating in the activity for which the reservation was made may use portions of the Commons not occupied by the reserving group so long as they do not interfere with or disturb the activities of the reserving group. Access full policy at this link. (https://www.ramapo.edu/policies/policy/padovano-commons-usage/)

question: Do I still owe anything to the college? I need to clear my balance before graduation

body.answer:
I can't see your personal records, like your grades, balance, schedule or financial aid status.

**Student Accounts**
All delinquent balances must be paid in full and funds must be cleared before students are eligible to register for classes or receive their diploma upon completion of their program. [2]
In addition to checking your Ramapo e-Mail account, it is important to log onto the RCNJ Experience (Web Self-Service) ([https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)) to periodically view your student account. Account balances can change when additional charges, such as a parking fine, or financial aid is reduced. In many instances, students are not aware that they have a balance due on their account. [6]

**Registrar**
Students with balances will be unable to receive their diploma and/or transcript until the balance is paid. [16]

- **Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [25]
- **Registrar**: Phone: (201) 684-7695. Email: reg@ramapo.edu. Office: D-224. [25]

question: I got a credit balance on my student account after my aid posted, how do I get that money sent to me? Do I need to sign up for direct deposit or does it just get mailed?

body.answer:
**Student Accounts**
Log into RCNJ Experience ([https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)) Locate the Student Account Info card Click on Bill & Payment Suite Click on Electronic Refunds on the right hand side of the screen under the My Profile Setup menu You must enroll in a Two-Step Verification Process (If previously completed, skip this step) Click on the Security Settings tab in My Profile Select a method to receive a passcode (text message, email or Google Authentication) Click the Send Code button Enter the passcode and click the Verify button Click on the Payment Profile tab in My Profile Edit existing saved Payment Method or Create New Payment Method When either editing an existing payment method or creating a new one, click on check box in the Refund Option section to designate this payment method as the refund account for direct deposit. [1]
Should a Title IV financial aid overpayment result in a credit balance of $1.00 or greater, a refund will be issued. Credit balances from non-Title IV financial aid are subject to a $5.00 threshold. Unless otherwise specified by the student, the College will issue a paper check. Paper Check Refund – Checks will be mailed to the student’s billing/permanent address. Spring refund proceeds cannot be applied to the following fall term Electronic/Direct Deposit Refund – This free electronic refund service will deposit refunds directly into a student’s checking or savings account Sign up for Electronic Refunds ([https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit/](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit/)) Learn More About Electronic Refunds ([https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit-questions-answers/](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit-questions-answers/)) The College reserves the right to change costs, dates and procedures at its discretion. [2]

question: how do i switch roommates? we're not getting along at all

body.answer:
Roommate problems are really common, and they can be worked out. Your RA is a good first step.

1. Housing & Residence Life says residents requesting a room change must submit a Room Change Request Form during an open room change period. [1]
2. For Spring 2027, submit the form through the Room Change Process Website by November 24, 2026 at 11:59pm. [4][5]
3. Visit [https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/) for step-by-step details and the digital form, which is available during active room change periods. [7][8]
4. Review the full process and the Residence Life Events & Important Dates calendar ([https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/critical-housing-dates-deadlines-calendar/](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/critical-housing-dates-deadlines-calendar/)) to see how a change might affect you; room changes are not guaranteed. [9]
5. Once the open room change period ends, contact your hall office for guidance on available options. [3]

**Housing & Residence Life**: Phone: (201) 684-7461. Email: reslife@ramapo.edu. [22]

This office can help:
**Ombuds Office**: Phone: (201) 684-7804. Email: jwoods1@ramapo.edu. [23]

question: Missed 3 classes last week because I was in the hospital. How do I get my professors to excuse the absences, is there an office that sends a note or something?

body.answer:
I'm sorry you're dealing with that, and I hope you feel better soon.

1. Admissions: Speak with your instructors to determine how to make up missed work; course attendance is determined by the instructor. [2]
2. Office of Specialized Services: You are responsible for accounting to your instructors for the absence. Contact the faculty member after any absence to determine if and when work may be made up. [11]

- **Admissions**: Phone: (201) 684-7300. Email: admissions@ramapo.edu. Location: McBride House. [19]
- **Office of Specialized Services**: Phone: (201) 684-7514. Email: oss@ramapo.edu. Location: C-Wing, Room 205. [19]

These offices can help:
- **Health Services**: Phone: (201) 684-7536. Location: Near the campus South Gate entrance at the corner of Route 202 and Hornbeam Road. [20]
- **Center for Student Success (Academic Advising)**: Phone: (201) 684-7441. Email: success@ramapo.edu. Office: D-207. [20]

Sources: [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/adult-students/faqs/) [11](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/disabilities-and-teaching-strategies-accommodations/) [19](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/) [20](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: can alumni still use career services and the library after graduating

body.answer:
Yes. The Office of Alumni Relations says alumni can use the library’s online services, borrow books and access the Learning Commons [1]. Alumni can also access the Cahill Career Center services on the Ramapo campus, including help with job searches, resume updates and interviewing skills [2].

**Student Accounts**
Pending Financial Aid, also known as estimated or anticipated aid, appear in separate sections on the Account Summary screen. Memos are pending financial aid transactions that require further action. question: How do I set up a payment plan for spring semester tuition? and is there a fee to enroll in it

body.answer:
Student Accounts: Spring 2027 payment plans are available beginning November 16, 2026, with four-month and five-month options. [1]
1. Enroll online by logging into RCNJ Experience before the semester’s posted payment deadline. [4]
2. Choose the five-month plan with a 20% down payment or the four-month plan with a 25% down payment. [2]
3. At enrollment, pay your down payment and the non-refundable $60 set-up fee; both are due then. [3][6]
4. Enrollment and the down payment are due by the appropriate payment deadline, with additional payments due on the 15th of each month thereafter. [5]
Students who miss the payment deadline may be subject to a $200 late fee and/or deregistration from their courses. Enrolling after the down payment due date requires payment of any missed installments at enrollment. [7]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [21]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/options-policies/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/affordability/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/affordability/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/faq/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/payment-policies/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/costinfo/course-fee/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/summer/policies/) [21](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

facts.says: Spring 2027 Payment Plan Ramapo College offers two monthly payment plan options for the Spring semester beginning November 16, 2026, a four-month and a five-month plan.
The Ramapo Tuition Payment Plan (RTPP) for Spring requires a $60 set-up fee and a 20% down payment for the five-month plan, and a 25% down payment for the four-month plan.
Both are due at the time of enrollment.
Students must enroll in the plan prior to the posted payment deadline for the semester and enrollment must be done online by logging into RCNJ Experience.
The terms of the plan are as follows: Enrollment and the down payment for the plan is due by the appropriate payment deadline, with additional payments due on the 15th of each month thereafter.
You must pay your down payment along with your non-refundable $60 set-up fee at the time of enrollment.

Students who do not enroll by the payment deadline may be subject to a $200 late fee and/or deregistration from their courses Enrollment in the plan beyond the due date for the down payment requires payment of any missed installments at the time of enrollment.

question: what is the policy on withdrawing from a class after the deadline and does it affect my aid/satisfactory academic progress

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [23]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

**Financial Aid**
In order to receive financial aid, students must maintain Satisfactory Academic Progress add Sap policy link [https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/policies/#s1](https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/policies/#s1) ([https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/policies/#s1k](https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/policies/#s1k)). Students must file their 2023-2024 FAFSA form by the May 1 deadline. [3]

**Office of the Provost**
Dropping or withdrawing from a course may affect issues concerning, but not limited to, financial aid eligibility, satisfactory progress towards graduation, athletic compliance, housing status, and involvement in campus activities and functions. [6]

**Registrar**
Students may Withdraw from a course as follows: Web Self Service Instructions: Students may withdraw from a course online through Web Self Service by following the steps below Withdrawing from a Course ([https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2026/03/Withdrawing.pdf](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2026/03/Withdrawing.pdf)) Students with Registration Hold: Students who have holds can withdraw using the Withdrawal Form or by sending an email from their Ramapo Email Account toreg@ramapo.edu (mailto:reg@ramapo.edu) stating the following. Your Name (First and Last) Ramapo ID Number (aka R#) CRN (Course Identification Number) Subject (Example: INTD) Course Number (Example 100) Section Number (Example 01) Title of the Course A student may NOT withdraw after the published deadline. [13]

- **Financial Aid**: Phone: (201) 684-7549. Email: finaid@ramapo.edu. Office: E-210. [24]
- **Office of the Provost**: Phone: (201) 684-7330. Email: provost@ramapo.edu. Location: first floor of the Birch Mansion. [24]

question: is my 1098-T available yet? need it for taxes and cant find where to get it. also how do i get a copy of last years

body.answer:
No—the current-tax-year 1098-T is provided on or before January 31, so it isn’t due yet. [1]
Student Accounts: The 1098-T is an IRS form for tax purposes; it may help students and families determine eligibility for the Hope Scholarship or Lifetime Learning Tax Credit. [1] The form reports the prior tax year, January 1 through December 31, not the academic year. [1] Forms are not mailed. [2]
To get last year’s copy:
1. Log into RCNJ Experience ([https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)). [2]
2. Open the Student Account Info card, then click Bill & Payment Suite. [2]
3. Click My Account, select Statements, then click the 1098-T Tax Statements tab. [2]
4. Click View for the appropriate tax year; the PDF can be printed or saved. [2]
To receive a printed copy for the current tax year only, complete the Revocation of Electronic 1098T form ([https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/wp-content/uploads/sites/147/2026/02/Revocation-of-Electronic-1098T_2026.pdf](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/wp-content/uploads/sites/147/2026/02/Revocation-of-Electronic-1098T_2026.pdf)) and submit it to the Office of Student Accounts; it will be printed within 5-7 business days and mailed to the home address on file with the Registrar’s Office. [2]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [24]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/taxinfo/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/taxinfo/) [24](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

Yes. The Center for Student Involvement says J. Lee’s is the unofficial Commuter Lounge, where students can relax before or after classes; it has video games, a pool table, a ping pong table, and FREE POPCORN! [5] The fee is $10.00 for the semester or $20.00 for the academic year; a key is issued with payment and must be returned at the end of the semester. question: what is the deadline to drop a class without a W and how do i do it

body.answer:
I can't send messages or make changes for you, like registering, dropping a class or making a payment.

The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [25]:

- Tuesday, September 1, 2026: Full Semester Courses - Last Day of Add/Drop for 100% Tuition Refund (already passed)
- Wednesday, October 21, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Add/Drop for 100% Tuition Refund (already passed)
- Thursday, December 17, 2026: Last Day to Add/Drop Winter Classes with 100% Tuition Refund (also on the Winter 2027 calendar)

The deadline to drop without a W is not specified here; the Registrar directs students to review the Academic Calendar: [https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/) [21]

1. Complete the withdrawal online in the Experience Webapp: [https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/) [21]
2. Submit a request through your Ramapo e-mail account stating your intent to withdraw from the course. [21]

question: my roommate keeps having his girlfriend sleep over like 5 nights a week. is there a guest policy and who do i talk to about it

body.answer:
Roommate problems are really common, and they can be worked out. Your RA is a good first step.

Housing & Residence Life defines visitors who spend more than three days within a given week as prohibited residents. [10] Talk to your roommate about concerns with his guest; you can also notify your residence hall office staff as soon as possible about a guest-policy violation. [1]

body.answer:

All students planning to park on campus are required to display a current and valid parking permit on their vehicle. [14]

question: is it too late to withdraw from a class this semester and what happens to my transcript if i do

body.answer:
That's a big decision, and it's worth talking it through with someone before you decide.

The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [23]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

It depends on which session your course is in. [23] Office of the Provost: You may withdraw after the 50% refund period, but no later than the last day to withdraw from a course, as indicated on the academic calendar ([https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/)), by accessing a withdrawal form online, completing a course withdrawal form in the Office of the Registrar, or withdrawing online through Web Self Service. [1] Once the withdrawal form is processed by the Office of the Registrar, you will receive a W for the withdrawn course, and both you and the instructor of record will receive notification that you have withdrawn from the course. [1]

**Office of the Provost**: Phone: (201) 684-7330. Email: provost@ramapo.edu. Location: first floor of the Birch Mansion. [24]

These offices can help:
- **Center for Student Success (Academic Advising)**: Phone: (201) 684-7441. Email: success@ramapo.edu. Office: D-207. [25]
- **Counseling Center**: Phone: (201) 684-7522. Office: D-216. [25]
- **Financial Aid**: Phone: (201) 684-7549. Email: finaid@ramapo.edu. Office: E-210. [25]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#dropping-or-withdrawing-from-a-course1) [23](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/) [24](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/) [25](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

Offices: C-102 [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/) [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/) [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/how-to-report/) [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-permits/) [campus-directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/report-an-incident/)

Hours: Monday to Sunday: 24 hours. Start date: not published. End date: not published. Published note: The Public Safety Department is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year. [campus-hours](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/get-support/)

Contact note: If there is an imminent danger to a student, or to the community, contact the Public Safety Department at \(201\) 684-6666.
